sections.text: However you choose to give, we are incredibly grateful for your support. In giving towards our work you’re helping empower people in the East End to build a fairer and happier society.
You can donate now online, or use one of the options below to get your gift to us.

Just send your donation (cheque or CAF Voucher) to: The Fundraising Team, Toynbee Hall, 28 Commercial Street, London E1 6LS. Please make sure you include a covering note with your details, so we can acknowledge your donation and say thank you.
Just email or call us to find out how to make a bank transfer to Toynbee Hall or set up a regular Standing Order or Direct Debit: fundraising@toynbeehall.org.uk or 020 7392 2970.
